_synthetic: Written synthetic-from-capture, made-up values: a message whose only text is a YouTube link, as a Trouter delivery gave it to the sender's own page on 2026-11-16 (lab account a's web client, a's 1:1 chat with b; read locally for its shape only). The compose box asked the YouTube app (com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.youtube, through the chat service's composeExtension/anonymousQueryLink invoke) for the link's card and sent it in properties.cards: a JSON string of a list, each entry appId, cardClientId, appName, appIcon (in the delivered form, the async gateway's urlp content link of the app's icon), contentType application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive and content, an Adaptive Card 1.6: a Media element (one source, video/mp4, the watch link), the title (large, bolder, at most 4 lines), the channel and the views and age (subtle, one line each), an ActionSet with an Open Action.Submit whose msteams invoke is a tab/tabInfoAction, and the same action as the card's selectAction. The content ends in an InputExtension span naming the card's cardClientId; properties.links has the link with previewenabled false. The video id, the title, the channel, the counts, the card and entity ids and the icon's path are made up; the delivery dropped the elements' separator: false, as here. <guid:entity> stands for the tab's entityId; <guid:a>, <guid:b> are lab accounts' object ids; tests fill them in. See docs/protocol/chat.md, App cards.
